flags.why: Rolling something into a ball is a meaning of vo, whereas vò means rubbing or crumpling it ([VDict](https://vdict.com/vo%2C3%2C0%2C0.html)).
flags.fix: Move this sense to vo and correct the example to: Bà vo bột thành những viên nhỏ để nấu chè.

flags.why: Trá means cleaning gold objects to restore their colour and shine, rather than covering something with gold ([Wiktionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/tr%C3%A1)).
flags.fix: to clean and polish gold objects; example: Người thợ trá đôi hoa tai bằng vàng. = The craftsman cleans and polishes the gold earrings.
